question: 结论可复现率的量化计算公式：Reproducibility_Rate = Count(Consistent_Significant_PValues) / Total_Trials，其中 Consistent_Significant_PValues 定义为在 K 次独立重复实验中 p-value < 0.05 的次数与首次实验 p-value < 0.05 的状态一致的数量；需设定最小样本量 N_min=10 以保证统计功效 Power ≥ 0.8。

sources.title: Reproducibility - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Reproducibility, closely related to replicability and repeatability, is a major principle underpinning the scientific method. For the findings of a study to be reproducible means that results obtained by an experiment or an observational study or in a statistical analysis of a data set should be achieved again with a high degree of reliability ...
